title: DINO-WM Tokens
abstract: How much can you shrink a visual world model before planning breaks? DINO-WM plans over 196 DINOv2 patch tokens per frame, while LeWM plans over a single learned vector and is about 60 times faster. This study keeps the frozen DINOv2 encoder, reduces its grid to 1, 4, 16 or 49 tokens by pooling or a small learned readout, retrains only the predictor, and measures planning success against planning time on TwoRoom and PushT.
highlight: On TwoRoom, four frozen tokens match the full grid at 100% success in 1/29 of the planning time. On PushT a learned readout recovers part of what pooling discards.
